description: This Java class 'KeywordSearchUtil' provides utility methods for keyword processing, including tokenization, stemming, stop-word filtering, keyword expansion, and configuration retrieval related to keyword search functionality.

classes.name: KeywordSearchUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for keyword processing in search functionalities, including tokenization, removing stop words, stemming, expanding keywords with thesaurus relations, and configuration parameter retrieval.

methods.name: getSeparators
methods.description: Returns the string of separator characters used to tokenize keywords, configurable via properties.

methods.name: getStopWordBagOr
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for OR operations from properties.

methods.name: getStopWordBagAnd
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for AND operations from properties.

methods.name: getRemoveStems
methods.description: Checks and returns whether stemming removal is enabled based on properties.

methods.name: getStemSet
methods.description: Returns a set of stem strings configured from properties for stemming purposes.

methods.name: processForKeywords
methods.description: Processes an input string to extract keywords with various options, updating the provided map.

methods.name: processKeywordsForIndex
methods.description: Processes a string into keywords suitable for indexing, using provided separators, stop words, and stemming options.

methods.name: fixupKeywordSet
methods.description: Cleans and normalizes a keyword set by removing stop words, applying stemming, and adding prefix/suffix wildcards as needed.

methods.name: makeKeywordSet
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a set of keywords based on separators, applying case normalization and wildcard replacements for searches.

methods.name: fixKeywordsForSearch
methods.description: Converts a set of keywords into a normalized form suitable for search, applying prefix/suffix wildcards and stemming.

methods.name: expandKeywordForSearch
methods.description: Expands an input entered keyword by querying thesaurus relationships via entity delegation, optionally replacing the entered keyword.
